name: bungkus-cli
description: The bungkus plugin: scaffold projects with bungkus-cli from a plain-language request

plugins.name: bungkus
plugins.description: Scaffold full-stack projects with bungkus-cli: a frontend (Astro/Nuxt/Vite) with a batteries-included optional backend (Hono/Elysia + ORM/database, /health-check, monorepo), translating a plain-language request into the correct `bungkus-cli create` command, reading valid options from the tool's own --help so flag values are never guessed

plugins.name: bungkus-canary
plugins.description: Pre-release build of the bungkus plugin, from the main branch. For testing the plugin before a stable release; install bungkus instead for normal use.
